vintage_rule: earliest XBRL filing at or before the episode availability cutoff
restatements_rejected_note: later restatements are recorded as rejections during selection and never overwrite the original filing

unavailable_control_series.high_yield_spread: ICE BofA high-yield option-adjusted spread (BAMLH0A0HYM2) is licensed and the public CSV returns only a rolling three-year window, so history before 2023 is not reachable.
unavailable_control_series.investment_grade_spread: ICE BofA investment-grade option-adjusted spread (BAMLC0A0CM) is truncated to a rolling three-year window on the public endpoint.
unavailable_control_series.speculative_default_rate: Rating-agency speculative-grade default rates are not published on a freely accessible endpoint; business_loan_delinquency is ingested as a labelled proxy and is not a substitute.
unavailable_control_series.equity_index_pe: Index-level earnings multiples require an index-provider licence.
unavailable_control_series.equity_index_concentration: Index constituent weights require an index-provider licence or N-PORT parsing that is out of scope for the control layer.
